gemini-3-flash.notes: Good CRA structure and exploit identification, but CVE counts don't match source (claims 32 vs actual 52). Well-organized but slightly verbose.

gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Decent CRA compliance coverage but significant accuracy issues with CVE counts (claims 61 vs actual 52). Missing some critical findings.

deepseek-v3.notes: Excellent CRA compliance focus with accurate CVE counts (52 total). Concise, comprehensive coverage of critical findings with clear prioritization.

analysis: DeepSeek-v3 delivers the most accurate and CRA-compliant summary with correct CVE counts and excellent prioritization of exploitable vulnerabilities. Gemini-3-flash provides good structure but has accuracy issues, while Gemini-2.5-flash significantly miscounts vulnerabilities and lacks precision in critical findings identification.
